## Problem and behavior

Describe the trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior.

## Scope and reuse

Name affected callers/contracts and the existing helper, component or platform
feature reused. Explain any new dependency or deliberate `shortcut:` limit.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. For UI changes name viewports and
browser engines. For GPS changes attach same-input accuracy evidence; live
quality/latency claims also need the paired provider benchmark and its failures.

## Remaining risks

State material untested behavior or limits; use “None identified” if appropriate.
